overview: The School Committee approved a district-wide expansion of a menstrual product program, introduced new principals for the high school, a middle school, and an elementary school, and passed a resolution supporting LGBTQ+ youth.

items.title: Photography Contest Recognition
items.summary: Coordinator of Fine Arts Suzanne Fee presented awards to the winners of the district photography contest, including Daryl Mendoza, Julia Hanready, Violet Veruso, Connor O'Leary, Nate Tacey, and Hannah Sophia McLaughlin.

items.title: Feminine Hygiene Product Pilot and Expansion
items.summary: Approved a motion to implement EGAL menstrual product dispensers in all middle and high school bathrooms, as well as upper elementary schools, following a presentation on a successful pilot at Andrews Middle School.

items.title: Introduction of New Principals
items.summary: The Superintendent introduced Jennifer Skane as the new principal of Andrews Middle School and Michelle Crowell as the new principal of Roberts Elementary School.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to discuss strategy for negotiations with Teamsters Local 25 and to address the Deion versus Medford School Committee litigation.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Subcommittee Reports
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes and reports from the Special Education and DEI subcommittees, including a new non-discrimination statement and plans for safety data reviews.

items.title: Introduction of Medford High School Principal
items.summary: Marta Cabral was introduced as the new principal of Medford High School, becoming the first woman to hold the position.

items.title: School Committee Member Onboarding
items.summary: Approved the creation of a one-time subcommittee to develop an onboarding process for incoming School Committee members.

items.title: Superintendent Updates
items.summary: The Superintendent provided updates on high school graduation, athletic achievements, middle school mock trial success, and safety messaging initiatives related to gun violence prevention.

items.title: Resolution Supporting LGBTQ+ Youth
items.summary: Approved a resolution reaffirming the committee's support for the rights and dignity of LGBTQ+ youth and committing to improving district supports and safety policies.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for Rosaline Dello Russo, Richard Fusco, and James Rabbitt.
